hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: Tracks, stalks and reads the wilds for game.

trapper.name: Trapper
trapper.description: Sets snares and reads sign to find where animals and people have been.

fisher.name: Fisher
fisher.description: Reads water and weather and works a line.

guard.name: Guard
guard.description: Watches for threats and reads intent in a face.

scout.name: Scout
scout.description: Moves unseen ahead of the group and reports what is there.

thief.name: Thief
thief.description: Works locks, pockets and the shadows.

healer.name: Healer
healer.description: Mends wounds and knows the useful plants.

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.description: Reads the old languages, religions and hidden meanings.

smith.name: Smith
smith.description: Works hot metal and knows how a made thing fits together.

cook.name: Cook
cook.description: Feeds a camp and knows what is safe to eat.

farmer.name: Farmer
farmer.description: Knows crops, weather, livestock and the land.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.description: Reads a customer and closes a trade.

miner.name: Miner
miner.description: Works stone and notices a weak seam.

performer.name: Performer
performer.description: Holds a crowd and works it.
